name: Moretown Belle
tagline: Thirty-one screens and the biggest telly we've ever seen.
hoursNote: Sunday opening printed as "080.30" on the venue page; the homepage footer says 08.00.
landmark: a stroll through St Katharine Docks from the Tower of London
screensText: 31 UHD 4K screens, multi-screen walls and the biggest single TV in Europe (so they tell us)
outside: Big sunny garden at the front
history: Opened in 1997 in a brand-new office square as the Old Monk, then the Thomas More, then the Cape. We took it on and renamed it around 2019.
hire: Whole venue for up to 120 seated or 200 standing, or a semi-private area. Meetings, breakfast briefings and presentations by day; birthdays, leaving dos, Christmas parties and wedding receptions by night.

name: Duchess Belle
tagline: Flowers on every wall and the Power Station across the road.
hoursNote: Venue page hours. The homepage footer gives 07.00 opening.
landmark: opposite Battersea Power Station, up the road from Battersea Dogs Home
screensText: UHD screens and a multi-screen wall
outside: Two gardens: a sunny one at the back and a terrace at the front, with heaters for the colder months

rooms.summary: Eight cosy, compact rooms over two floors, every one with a king-size bed for one or two.

types.name: King Classic
types.text: King-size bed, own bathroom, TV, tea & coffee.

types.name: King Classic
types.text: Painted butterflies on the wall, flowers downstairs.

types.name: En-suite
types.text: Every room has its own bathroom.

rooms.goodFor: Battersea Power Station, the US Embassy, gigs at Evolution, shopping trips

timeline: The Duchess of York is built on this spot as part of Lovell & Peecock's Nine Elms development, named for the Duke of York's marriage to Princess Frederica Charlotte of Prussia.
Land around the pub is auctioned off in the bar, according to Keith Alan Bailey's The Metamorphosis of Battersea.
The old pub comes down and the building you're sitting in goes up.
She becomes the Duchess Belle. The flowers arrive and never leave.
hire: The first-floor bar and balcony looks straight across at Battersea Power Station. Wedding receptions, birthdays, baby showers, hen and stag dos and wakes, at a price that won't make you wince.

Bombed out in the Blitz.
Rebuilt on the same spot.
Renamed the Fitzrovia Belle. These days there's a piano in the front bar.
hire: Birthdays, anniversaries, company gatherings, leaving dos, wedding receptions and wakes, across two bars.

timeline: Trading as the Builders Arms.
Later
Wyvils, then the Vauxhall Griffin.
Renamed the Griffin Belle, after the griffin on the badge of Vauxhall Motors, whose iron works started on Wandsworth Road.
Wins Live Sports Venue at the Star Pubs & Bars Awards, sponsored by Sky Sports.
hire: Birthdays, anniversaries, company gatherings, leaving dos, wedding receptions and wakes. Watch parties for the whole team, then fourteen beds upstairs.

screensText: 13 UHD screens including two super screens, plus TVs in the garden pergola
outside: The Belle Enchanted Garden: 8,000 sq ft for up to 300, beach huts, a kids' castle and an all-weather sports pergola

types.name: Double

types.name: Twin
types.text: Two singles under a stained-glass ceiling.

rooms.goodFor: Ravenscourt Park, the river at Hammersmith, and families visiting west London

timeline: Licensed as the Hogs, after the Royal Hampshire Regiment (not the pigs).
Rebuilt by Sich's Chiswick brewery. The grand fireplace at the back is still here.
Jan 2025
Reopens as the Hammersmith Belle after a £1m refurbishment.
May 2025
Rosie Galligan and Cllr Zarar Qayyum cut the ribbon on the garden.
hire: Beach huts for your own little corner of the garden, private areas inside, and the whole garden for up to 300 when you've got something big to celebrate.
